parameters.returnWindowStrict: at least one event at day offset N..N+graceDays
parameters.reviewReturn: returning event's session contains mission.started{mode:review} or review.started{reason:due|overdue}

retention.cohortDefinition: first mission.completed{result:completed} on UTC day D0

wideCohortRetention.cohortDefinition: first onboarding.completed on UTC day D0

trackEntrySplit.definition: installations with ≥1 mission.started{mode:initial}, by ISO week of the first one; split by its trackId

missionCompletion.definition: installations with ≥1 mission.started (n) vs ≥1 mission.completed{result:completed}, per missionId context; missing missionId ⇒ unattributed

activityFriction.definition: structured_attempt.passed/submitted per activityType × missionId; hint.requested/retry.requested counted per missionId (those events carry no activityType)

verificationHealth.definition: verification.state_changed events by state (bridge-level state; no missionId in the cut)

rendererDegraded.definition: renderer.degraded events by fallback, with aggregated reasons and engineId context when present

moduleCompletionMedian.definition: per-module completion (same definition as missionCompletion, unioned over the module's missions) for ia_pratica modules mapped in the catalog; median across published modules
